hamiltonian.reference_label: paper exact Fe2S2 active-space energy plus listed core energy

settings_rationale.recommended_setting: Kprop=20000, Kstore=200000, m_cycle=10, nroot=3, CKCI-0 every Krylov iteration
settings_rationale.reason: The Cr2 CKCI-0 runs showed that m_cycle=10/nroot=3 is the practical checkpoint cadence for expensive exactized diagnostics. Fe2S2 CAS(30e,20o) is larger than Cr2 CAS(12e,22o), so the retained store is increased above the Cr2 50k CKCI-0 run while keeping Kprop high enough to discover a broad connected shell each Krylov step.
settings_rationale.fallback_if_too_slow: Use Kprop=10000 and Kstore=50000 with the same m_cycle=10/nroot=3 for a shorter pilot.
settings_rationale.fallback_if_memory_limited: Use Kprop=10000 and Kstore=100000, or keep Kprop=20000 and reduce Kstore to 50000.
